0022600190.text: The Atlanta Hawks, 6-4 and first in the Southeast, host the Brooklyn Nets, who are 2-6 and 13th in the East, on a three-game Hawks win streak. Atlanta has beaten Brooklyn in all four of their 2025-26 meetings, most recently 141-107 in Brooklyn on April 3, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet. Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Noah Clowney is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision.
